decoy_control.note: box translated +30 A along x. The interpretable signal here is the SCORE MAGNITUDE, not the CI: a 10-pair block leaves only 9 comparable pairs of 45, so both CIs are noise-level and are reported as such. The shifted box losing ~2 kcal/mol of fitted strength is the specificity evidence.

caveats: docked poses come from RDKit ETKDG+MMFF of the DAVIS canonical SMILES, not from any crystal structure; single tautomer/protonation state, no pH model
receptor is rigid (side chains fixed at the co-crystal conformation) and one apo/cryo structure stands in for a whole kinase
the search box is centred on a DIFFERENT compound (the co-crystal ligand), so a DAVIS ligand that binds elsewhere is scored in the wrong site
69.6% of DAVIS pKd values sit at the assay ceiling (Kd clipped at 10000 nM), which caps any correlation with a continuous score
the docked subset is a pKd-stratified sample of 20 compounds on a handful of kinases, so per-target CI is estimated from ~20 points and is noisy by construction
Vina scores are compared to a trained model that has seen the rest of the assay table; on identical rows that asymmetry is removed, and only ranking quality is compared
